entries.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: high-resolution production cutout atlas for a Sengoku Japanese 2D side-scrolling beat-em-up. Create ONE square 2048x2048 image with a strict 3 columns by 3 rows grid of NINE independent sprites, transparent alpha everywhere around objects and visibly transparent openings inside rails and between grass blades. No opaque ground, no painted background, no checkerboard, no drop shadows, no text or grid lines. Each complete sprite must fit in the central 70 percent of its cell, with at least 70 pixels clear padding on every side. Accurate sharp realistic painted 2D game art with tangible wood grain, rope knots, soil clods and leaves; warm natural daylight, coherent front three-quarter view slightly above foot level, similar to detailed historical strategy game assets, not cartoon. Row 1 left to right: (1) a long low irregular clump of wild grasses with varying heights and gaps, multiple tufts in a single landscape sprite (2) a low spreading green shrub grouping with uneven silhouette and visible sparse branches (3) a low irregular brown earthen berm with a few rocks and sparse grasses. Row 2 left to right: (4) a taller uneven brown dirt mound with grass on its shoulder (5) a horizontal old wood guardrail with three posts and two rails, large completely transparent open spaces between them (6) a horizontal sparse bamboo-and-rope rail, large transparent gaps between poles. Row 3 left to right: (7) a low dark wooden lattice railing for a Japanese interior, spacious transparent open grid, no wall behind it (8) a freestanding Japanese three-panel folding screen with aged cream paper painted with understated pine branches, fully visible dark wooden frame and small feet (9) a heavy freestanding solid wooden storage cabinet with two doors and two drawers, dark aged cedar, black iron hinges and handles, sturdy low feet. No people, weapons, clan symbols, buildings, foliage behind the furniture or modern objects. All nine sprites isolated with clean natural antialiased alpha edges. Preserve ample empty cell margins rather than filling the sheet.

entries.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Transform the supplied Sengoku camp panorama into a DISTINCT Japanese enclosed garden courtyard panorama for a horizontal 2D beat-em-up. Keep the same realistic painted-game rendering quality, orthographic-feeling side-on camera, wide 16:9 aspect, warm subdued natural color and crisp high-resolution details. Replace ALL camp tents, supply huts, bamboo forest and military provisions with a refined garden: a low plaster-and-timber perimeter wall with dark tiled eaves, a carefully pruned spreading pine, a small garden pond mostly behind the far walkway, clusters of mossy garden stones and low green bushes, with a distant simple wooden residential veranda behind the wall on one side. Arrange the garden across the upper half, viewed from the front rather than looking down a road. The broad bottom 45 percent must remain open, mostly flat pale compacted earth and subtle fine gravel suitable for side-scrolling combat, without large obstacles or objects in the fighting lane. The boundary of garden and combat ground should be irregular with clusters of grass, moss and stones rather than an obvious perfectly horizontal hard line. Do not reuse the military camp layout. No characters, text, signs, flags, torii gate, castle keep, mist blur, artificial vignette or depth of field. High detail, visually readable horizontal layers, soft early daylight after rain, natural tree and architecture silhouettes. Opaque background image, full landscape.
